keyFindings.description: The diff created a dangling `rank` reference in a text agents read. Line 40 still says "A closed issue takes only `rank`, `components`, a reopening status, and an external-links write that adds no link." Before this diff that word was anchored by line 46, which named the `rank` body field of a hand-built PATCH; the diff replaced line 46 with the `--before`/`--after` command and reworded the identical sentence in the tool description to "A closed issue takes only a board move (before, after), components, …" (packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.ts:417-419), leaving :40 as the one text that still names a field an agent cannot set: `dispatch_issue_update` is strict and has no `rank` argument, pinned at packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.test.ts:565, so no `--rank` flag is generated. Acceptance criterion A4 asks that the texts agents read send nobody to a hand-built request; :40 is the sentence that still does. Remediation: say "a board move (`--before` / `--after`)" there, as the tool description now does. Found independently by both thermonuclear agents (deep-review Minor 2, code-quality rank 1).

`dispatch_issue_update`'s `example` was not updated although the argument shape changed. packages/contracts/AGENTS.md:62 states the rule without condition: "Every Dispatch spec includes `example`, a schema-valid call that `dispatch <command> --help` and every refusal print as a command line; update it with any argument-shape change." Verified at this head that the example is the one line every refusal prints: `bun packages/envoy-client/bin/dispatch.ts issue-update --issue SMOKE-1` answers `Example: dispatch issue-update --issue DSP-1 --status done --reason '…'`, which shows nothing of the move this issue exists to deliver (the allowed-flag list does name --before/--after, and `--help` carries both descriptions, so the gap is the example alone). Remediation: one string, plus the schema-validity assertion that already covers every example at packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.test.ts:298. The architect asked for this in this round rather than after it.

The new executor test covers `before`, `after`, both, and the no-neighbour case, but not an empty neighbour. `before: ""` is the case the guard's shape (`rankBefore === undefined`) deliberately passes through so the server refuses it (`RANK_INPUT: rank neighbor must name another issue`, packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/issue_rank.go), and the contract test records that intent in a comment only (packages/contracts/src/dispatch-tools.test.ts:470-472). A later falsy or trimming guard would turn that loud server refusal into a PATCH with no `rank` key that still satisfies the "at least one field besides issue" rule — a call that prints success and moves nothing. One assertion in the test the diff already adds locks it.

declined.description: The code-quality pass asked that `IssueRankInput` be narrowed to a union so `rank: {}` becomes a compile error. Declined for this pull request: that type is the shared Dispatch wire shape generated into Go and consumed by the server, so narrowing it is a change to the API contract rather than to this diff, and the runtime guard (packages/envoy-client/src/dispatch-execute.ts:2885-2891, the only producer) plus its unit lock already make the empty shape unreachable.

The tester and the architect both noted that `dispatch issues` orders by status bucket first and rank second, so a neighbour in another status column ranks the card correctly project-wide while the listing shows it among its own status. Not asked for: it is true of the board before this change, the acceptance criteria use one status throughout, and the controller's own listings filter by a single status (skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md:154, :330), where the grouping is invisible.
